quick-action.name: Quick Action
quick-action.purpose: Expose one compact shortcut command with icon, label, and state without becoming a quick-actions grid, speed dial, or process chooser.

anatomy.rule: Single circular shortcut target; label remains external text below the circle.
Action symbol that supports the label.
Focus, loading, warning, pressed, and disabled state.

quick-action.statePrecedence: disabled > loading > warning > pressed > focus > hover > default

Energy.decision: Use semantic surface, action, status, and border color.
Energy.behavior: Operational status remains legible without raw colors.

Voice.decision: Use concise labels, status, and metadata.
Voice.behavior: Users can scan the item without entering a pattern.

Frame.decision: Use stable mobile-first geometry and target size.

Depth.decision: Use elevation only to separate the component from its surface.
Depth.behavior: Depth clarifies hierarchy without creating workspace behavior.
Depth.rejectIf: Depth implies a modal or process.

Momentum.decision: Use Design System transitions for hover, focus, loading, and pressed states.
Momentum.behavior: State changes feel responsive and respect reduced motion.

State.decision: Use explicit state precedence from the contract.
State.example: disabled > loading > warning > pressed > focus > hover > default

Tone.decision: Use warning or danger only with visible reason.
Tone.behavior: Risk is communicated through copy and state.

Growth.decision: Escalate grouping, actions, detail, or orchestration to patterns.

Symbol.decision: Use symbols as support for visible labels or accessible names.
Symbol.behavior: Icons aid recognition without replacing meaning.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon sizing and optical alignment.
Iconography.behavior: Symbols align with text and target size.

Accessibility.decision: Expose label, status, focus, keyboard behavior, and non-color state.
Accessibility.behavior: Assistive technology can operate or understand the component.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Shape and risk emphasis for one shortcut.

props.name: state
props.notes: Visual state for documentation and controlled previews.

props.name: density
props.notes: Scales icon target and label size through Flow density.

props.name: tone
props.notes: Legacy tone shortcut; danger maps to destructive.

do: Compose groups with the Quick Actions Grid pattern.
dont: Do not put multiple commands in one Quick Action.
Do not use icon-only shortcuts without accessible names.
Do not use it as global navigation.

agentInstructions: Use Quick Action for freeze card, scan receipt, start route, contact support, or add note when each is a standalone command.
Use destructive variant only with clear visible label.
Compose several Quick Actions through a pattern, not inside this component.
rejectIf: Quick Action contains more than one command.
Multiple actions are managed inside the component.
Label is missing or icon-only is ambiguous.
quick-action.referenceRationale: The ZIP has Button/IconButton and action compositions, but no direct Quick Action component. Flow treats Quick Action as one atomic shortcut; Quick Actions Grid and grouped action behavior remain patterns.
